cd-rock-falls-days-grove-1906.st: Where the grove stood comes only from the name: Jesse Day patented the N½ SW¼ of sec. 23 in 1858 (BLM GLO, accession WI0790__.204), and the 1915 plat shows L. C. Spaulding there with no Day in the township. That is not a second source for the grove itself, so the pin stays at C.
